# MIUI Plugin Mod **The MIUI SystemUI plugin with an AOSP-style control center.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin/stargazers)
> [!WARNING] > **Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated.** It's kept for MIUI 13–14 users. HyperOS users: see [HyperOS Plugin](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin). ## Features - AOSP-style UI - New tiles that you can pick - AOSP-style brightness bar - Monet colours in the control center by default ## Requirements - MIUI 13–14, Android 12/13 - Magisk ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk. 3. If the panel doesn't open, reboot once more. 4. Reboot your device. ## Notes - MIUI 14 (Android 13): Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module. - If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. Not for paid ROMs. ## Screenshots

MIUI Plugin Mod

The MIUI SystemUI plugin with an AOSP-style control center.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin/stargazers)

> [!WARNING]

> Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated. It's kept for MIUI 13–14 users. HyperOS users: see HyperOS Plugin.

Features

  • AOSP-style UI
  • New tiles that you can pick
  • AOSP-style brightness bar
  • Monet colours in the control center by default

    • Requirements

  • MIUI 13–14, Android 12/13
  • Magisk

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Miui_Plugin/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk.
  • If the panel doesn't open, reboot once more.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • MIUI 14 (Android 13): Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module.
  • If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. Not for paid ROMs.
